semantics.clock: Original: all sequential logic on positive clock edge; sample inputs at that edge and update Moore outputs after state update.
semantics.reset: Original: positive-edge asynchronous areset resets to walking left; while asserted clock edges also reset to walking left.
semantics.walking: Original: ground=0 takes priority and preserves direction into falling; otherwise dig=1 starts digging and preserves direction; otherwise bump on current walking side reverses direction, including simultaneous bumps.
semantics.falling: Original: ignore bump and dig; retain direction; ground=1 resumes walking in retained direction on that edge.
semantics.digging: Original: retain direction, ignore bumps and dig deassertion, remain digging while ground=1; ground=0 enters falling.
semantics.outputs: Moore: exactly one of walk_left, walk_right, aaah, digging asserted after reset; output depends only on registered state.
semantics.initialization: No pre-reset initial state specified; no declaration initialization added and no pre-reset value required by verification.

numeric.state: Six direction/activity states encoded in three bits

verification.oracle: Independent activity and direction model derived from original prose
verification.sampling: Drive away from rising clock; check unchanged Moore outputs before edge and check after NBA settling
verification.coverage: All 16 control combinations from all six states, direction retention across dig/fall, priorities, repeated cycles and asynchronous reset from each state
verification.success: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, explicit PASS; run mandatory dev_check.py initial

specification_ambiguities: Behavior before first reset and for unknown-valued inputs is unspecified; no additional functional requirements imposed.
